evals.prompt: I run Google Ads for local dentists. Mine the comments on the last 10 videos from a big dental marketing channel (pick one) and tell me what dentists are worried about, so I can write better ads and landing pages.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or confirms the channel handle, checks YOUTUBE_API_KEY without asking for it in chat, runs fetch_comments.py, writes tags.csv with specific themes in commenters' words, runs rank_themes.py, then gives the top themes with votes from the script, real quotes, ad angles and objection answers, and themes.xlsx

evals.prompt: Here's my channel: https://www.youtube.com/@mychannel. What should my next 5 videos be? Use what my viewers are asking for.
evals.expected_output: Reads the user's own latest uploads, ranks themes, and proposes video topics with 3 titles each, tied to the themes with the most votes, with quoted comments as evidence and a note on sample size if comments are few

evals.prompt: Pull the comments from https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ and https://youtu.be/9bZkp7q19f0 and tell me the most common questions.
